qa_pairs.question: If among all hotel operators who are aware of the new plastic restriction order, the proportion distribution of various promotions for the plastic restriction order is the same as the overall situation, what is the percentage of these operators who use promotional posters for publicity in the entire sample? Express it as a percentage and round to 3 decimal places.
qa_pairs.explanation: The proportion of those who are aware of the new plastic restriction order is well - informed (20%) + slightly informed (37%) = 57%. Among them, 5% have posted posters. The calculation is: 57% × 5% = 2.85%.

qa_pairs.question: Among all consumers who think the sustainable attribute is “relatively important” or “very important”, if the proportion of consumers who hope to be encouraged through “price discounts” is the same as the overall distribution, what is the proportion of these consumers in the entire sample? Express it as a percentage and round to 1 decimal place.
qa_pairs.explanation: The proportion of consumers who value sustainability is 65% + 27% = 92%. Among them, 58.9% expect price discounts. The calculation is: 92% × 58.9% = 54.188% ≈ 54.2%.

qa_pairs.question: Assume that among all guests who “do not need to replace disposable items daily”, the proportion of those who hope to get rewards through the point - incentive mechanism is the same as the overall distribution.
